Area.description: A tagged region weights and shading can read, and that Fill colors whole.

v.description: Around the surface. An end below its start runs on past 1 to it, crossing the seam at v = 0.

patch.description: The patch it lies on, or every one of a row of patches.

color.description: A palette slot it shows until it is filled.

round.description: Whether it is the oval inside its u and v rather than the whole rectangle: a pad.

AxisPlace.description: A place a curved axis passes through, in the part's own axes as fractions of its length.

along.description: Along the rest direction, away from the socket.

up.description: Toward the part's top; below 0 toward its underside.

side.description: Toward the part's side at v = 0.25.

AxisSpec.description: The rest direction before anything is drawn.

rest.description: From the socket end toward the tip, in body space.

length.description: How long the axis is with nothing drawn, in body units; the size parameter multiplies it.

bend.description: How far the axis sits toward the underside at bendAt with nothing drawn, as a fraction of its length.

bendAt.description: Where along the axis it bends.

curve.description: Places a smooth axis passes through after the socket point with nothing drawn, in the part's own axes as fractions of its length; the curve through them is scaled to the axis length, so they set its shape and length sets its reach. Empty for a straight or bent axis.

bearsWeight.description: Whether the part stands on the ground, so a lean on one such part shortens the others to keep them all on it.

faces.description: Where a head's face looks at rest, in body space, when not along the axis: the way its angle versions and gaze read.

Cap.description: Closes an end that is not a socket.

Digit.description: One digit of a toe row moved and angled apart from the fan, as a thumb is; a field left out keeps the row's.

index.description: The digit's place in the row, from 0.

u.description: Where the digit runs along the axis, in place of the row's span.

across.description: Where across the row the digit's root sits, -1 at the first side and 1 at the last.

angle.description: Degrees the digit turns from the axis toward the row's last side, in place of its place in the fan; past 90 either way it points back from its root.

joints.description: Where this digit's joints sit as shares of its span from its root, in place of the row's.

limits.description: Degrees this digit's joints turn within, in place of the row's, so each digit of a row can close along its own path.

DigitJoints.description: Joints along every digit of the row: where each sits as a share of the digit's span from its root, about which hinge, within which limits.

at.description: Each joint's place along a digit, from 0 at its root to 1 at its tip, ascending.

limits.description: Degrees; a positive tip turns the digit toward the row's underside.

DigitNail.description: A nail or a claw at each digit's tip: an oval on the digit's back centred at a share of its length, so long along it and so wide round it, in a palette slot; a claw stands out past the tip as a point and is painted to it.

name.description: The area's name; each digit's is this with its place after it.

if.description: The boolean parameter that switches the nails or claws on.

at.description: Its middle along the digit, from 0 at the root to 1 at the tip.

length.description: How long it runs along the digit, as a share of the digit's length.

width.description: How far round the digit it reaches, as a share of a turn.

color.description: The palette slot it shows until it is filled.

claw.description: How far a claw stands out past the tip, as a share of the digit's length, up to 2; 0 for a nail.

curl.description: How far a claw's point curls toward the digit's underside, as a share of the claw's length, -1 to 1.

DigitPad.description: A pad under each digit's tip: an oval on the digit's underside centred at a share of its length, so long along it and so wide round it, in a palette slot; with a rise, a ball raised under it on digits joined to a field.

name.description: The area's name; each digit's is this with its place after it.

if.description: The boolean parameter that switches the pads on.

at.description: Its middle along the digit, from 0 at the root to 1 at the tip.

length.description: How long it runs along the digit, as a share of the digit's length.

width.description: How far round the digit it reaches, as a share of a turn.

color.description: The palette slot it shows until it is filled.

rise.description: On digits joined to a field, the radius of the ball raised under it, as a share of the digit's radius; 0 paints it only.

DigitSegment.description: One digit: its root in the part's own axes (along, up, side) as fractions of the axis length, its direction, length and thickness.

toward.description: Along, up and side; it must run forward along the part.

length.description: A fraction of the axis length.

radius.description: Its radius at the root, a fraction of the axis length.

joints.description: Each joint's place along the digit, from 0 at its root to 1 at its tip, ascending.

hinge.description: The axis its joints turn about, in place of the row's.

limits.description: Degrees its joints turn within, in place of the row's.

roll.description: Degrees its rings turn about it, so v = 0.25 round it, where its nail lies, faces its back.

join.description: On digits joined to a field, how much wider than the row's its own join to the field is, as a factor: a thumb rising out of a pad.

knuckle.description: On digits joined to a field, its knuckle ball as a share of the row's knuckles: 0 for a digit rooted deep in a pad.

counts.description: The row counts it is built at, so a row holds a spread of digits for each count; unset on every digit, a count builds the first digits.

name.description: A name that sets the digit outside the row's count, built whatever the count, its patch, joints and marks named for it: a hind toe.

if.description: A flag that builds the named digit only while it is on.

DigitTips.description: A socket at the tip of every digit of the row, named for the digit with .tip after it; a part there sinks along its own axis and rides the digit's last joint.

takes.description: The templates a tip takes; every loaded template when empty, and an empty tip shows no planned part.

sink.description: Multiplies how deep a part on a tip sits inside the digit.

Digits.description: Digits placed one by one, each a straight rounded segment from its own root in its own direction with joints along it; named for the row and its place in it.

from.description: Where u = 0 lies along the axis from the socket plane, as a fraction of the axis length, as on the part's field.

count.description: How many of the digits, from the first, the part builds.

taper.description: Each digit's thickness at its tip as a share of its root's.

knuckle.description: How much each digit swells at each joint past its root, as a share of its thickness.

flat.description: How much thinner each digit is toward its neighbours than toward the back and the palm, as a share.

reach.description: Every digit's length is multiplied by this.

thickness.description: Every digit's thickness is multiplied by this.

spread.description: Every digit pointing forward has its angle from the part's axis, seen from above, multiplied by this: below 1 the digits close together, above it they fan out.

gap.description: On digits joined to a field, each digit's root sits this multiple of its distance across the part from the middle of the digits' roots: below 1 the roots close together, above it they stand apart.

hinge.description: Which of the part's axes the joints turn about, unless a digit names its own: x across, y about its up, z along it.

join.description: The radius, a fraction of the axis length, of the smooth union joining the digits to the part's field, so roots, webs and knuckles come out of one surface; unset, each digit is a run of its own.

merge.description: On digits joined to a field, the radius of the smooth union joining each digit to its neighbours, as a share of a digit's radius: small for fingers apart to their roots, 1 or more for toes that only part a rounded mass as lobes.

knuckles.description: On digits joined to a field, the radius of a ball at each digit's root toward its back, a knuckle, as a share of the digit's radius; 0 for none.

nail.description: A nail or a claw at each digit's tip: painted on its back, and on digits joined to a field standing out past the tip as a point.

pad.description: A pad under each digit's tip, a toe bean: painted on its underside, and on digits joined to a field raised from it.

surface.description: Whether the digits are in the body's field or each its own mesh sunk into the run before them.

Field.description: A run of rings cut through a smooth union of ellipsoids and capsules, placed in the part's own axes as fractions of the axis length.

u.description: The stretch of u the rings cover with the template's defaults.

from.description: Where u = 0 lies along the axis from the socket plane, as a fraction of the axis length; negative behind it.

parts.description: The solids, each joined to those before it by a smooth union of its blend radius.

floor.description: A flat floor the solid is cut at, a sole.

bend.description: A turn of everything past a point about the part's side axis, eased in along the axis: a forefoot kept flat on a pointed foot.

cup.description: How far the first solid's edges come toward the part's negative side, as a fraction of the axis length, growing as the square of how far they lie from its middle: a cupped palm. Digits joined to the field keep their roots on it.

fit.description: Whether drawn Side and Top outlines fit the whole solid, digits and all: its reach along the axis, and its height, width and midline at each point along it, take the drawing's, the template's numbers shaping what lies within.

FieldBend.description: A turn about the side axis through a point, toward the part's up for positive degrees, eased in along the axis from `from` to `to` past the point.

FieldFloor.description: A flat floor the field is cut at, up from the axis as a fraction of the axis length, joined by a smooth intersection.

FieldPart.description: One solid of a field, in the part's own axes (along, up, side) as fractions of the axis length.

name.description: A name an author can know the solid by, a palm or a heel.

at.description: The ellipsoid's centre, or the capsule's first end: along, up, side.

radii.description: The ellipsoid's semi-axes along, up and side.

radius.description: The capsule's radius at its first end.

toRadius.description: The capsule's radius at its second end; its first radius when left out.

blend.description: The radius of the smooth union joining this solid to those before it; 0 joins them by a plain union.

narrows.description: How much shorter the ellipsoid's side semi-axis is toward the part's start, as a share.

over.description: Over how far either side of the centre the narrowing eases in.

u.description: The stretch of u, as a share of the run.

share.description: The share of the ring spacings inside it.

GenericSpec.description: A generic template: each part chooses its section profile, the views that set it, and its rings and segments; the template's section, views and topology are the defaults.

rings.description: The fewest and most rings a part may take.

segments.description: The fewest and most control points a part's section may take.

GrainSpec.description: How the part's fur lies until a comb changes it.

toward.description: The end of the axis fur runs toward.

lift.description: How far a stroke rises for each unit it runs along the surface, where no ruff says otherwise.

blend.description: The blend of the smooth union where the part meets its parent, a fraction of the part's length along its first run; null takes a quarter of the least extent of that run's box.

ink.description: Whether the join is inked as a line round the part.

Joint.description: A bone boundary; bones are the spans between joints in u order.

Landmark.description: A named surface point face marks and sets anchor to.

Membrane.description: A web spanned between neighbouring digits of a toe row listed before it, or a digit and the part's own run, one patch a pair, named for the membrane and the pair's first digit.

on.description: The toe row whose digits it spans. The row is listed before the membrane.

reach.description: How far up the digits its free edge meets them, as a share of each digit's span from its root.

sag.description: How far its free edge dips toward its middle, as a share of its reach.

thickness.description: How thick it is half way between two digits, as a share of their thickness.

rings.description: Rings across it, from one digit to the other.

segments.description: Points round each ring, an even number.

between.description: The pairs of digits it spans; each digit with the next when left out, leaving out a digit turned back.

MembranePair.description: Two rails a membrane spans: a digit of the row by its place, and a second digit or, with along, the part's own run; reach in place of the membrane's.

along.description: The part's own run as the second rail, from u at the rail's root to u at its edge, in place of a second digit.

MountSpec.description: The point of a closed part that sits on its socket, in place of its axis start.

Pad.description: A raised area tagged with a palette slot, on the first run listed before it that reaches its u.

v.description: Around the surface; underneath when left out.

on.description: The toe row this pad repeats along, in place of u. The row is listed before the pad.

rings.description: Rings from the pad's inner point to its apex.

segments.description: Points around each of the pad's rings.

values.description: The only values it takes, ascending, in place of min and max. A value between them is never offered.

doc.description: What it does, in one line, as the generated reference shows it.

PartTemplate.description: A part template: axis, open end, sampling, blocks, parameters and which view sets what.

format.description: The grammar version of the file.

version.description: The template's own version; changes when what the template builds changes.

role.description: What a part of this type is to the body, which a part placed from it takes; none for a generic part, whose role is guessed from where it sits.

openEnd.description: The end that sits on the socket plane; null for a closed part.

mount.description: The point of a closed part that sits on its socket, in place of its axis start: a head carried under its middle.

profile.description: Reads the height view's up side as a profile whose short features stand out as a ridge; null reads it as an outline like any other.

section.description: The default section along u, used where no view sets it.

generic.description: Present on a generic template, whose parts choose their own section, views, rings and segments.

surface.description: Whether the part is in the character's field, or thin or hard and built as its own mesh sitting on the body.

join.description: How a part in the field joins the part its socket is on when the part sets neither its blend nor its join ink.

span.description: Features of the profile shorter than this share of the drawn length stand out as a ridge; longer ones, a forehead or a muzzle, swell the ring.

keel.description: How wide the ridge is, as a share of the ring's half width.

RuffSpec.description: A stretch of the body patch where fur stands outward from the surface instead of lying along it.

lift.description: How far a stroke rises for each unit it runs along the surface.

Skull.description: A rounded block whose slices run front to back.

width.description: Full side to side extent, as a fraction of the axis length; the skull's own length when left out.

depth.description: Full top to bottom extent, as a fraction of the axis length; the skull's own length when left out.

Socket.description: A child attachment point; pair makes a mirrored twin.

tilt.description: Degrees the outward normal turns toward the part's end.

sink.description: Multiplies how deep a child sits inside this part here.

ToeRow.description: A row of small tubes fanned across the end, each named for the row and its place in it. A count of 0 builds nothing.

spread.description: Degrees from the axis of the outermost toe.

v.description: Where around the run before it the row sits; underneath when left out.

segments.description: Control points of each toe's section.

digits.description: Digits moved and angled apart from the fan, by their place in the row.

flare.description: How much taller each digit is at its root than along its run, as a fraction of its thickness, easing out over the root's third; a drawn Side's heights are kept.

joints.description: Joints along every digit, which bend it toward the row's underside; a digit with none follows the part's bone at its root.

section.description: Each digit's cross-section, a named profile or control points; round when left out. It shapes drawn digits too.

width.description: Each digit's width as a multiple of its thickness; a drawn Top's widths are kept.

taper.description: Each digit's thickness at its tip as a share of its root's; a drawn Side's heights are kept.

knuckle.description: How much each digit swells at each of its joints, as a fraction of its thickness; a drawn digit's sizes are kept.

tips.description: A socket at every digit's tip, for a claw or a nail; none when left out.

surface.description: Whether the digits are in the body's field or each its own mesh sunk into the run before them.

segments.description: Control points of every section spline.

focus.description: A stretch of u that holds more than its share of the rings, as a face does; rings space evenly without it.

Tube.description: A run of slices; the views resize them.

radius.description: A fraction of the axis length.

taper.description: The radius at the far end, as a fraction of the radius at the near end.

width.description: The undrawn width as a fraction of the height: below 1 a run flat from side to side, above 1 one flat from top to bottom.

cup.description: How far the section's sides curl toward v = 0, as a fraction of its half span.

rim.description: How much the section's sides thicken toward their edges, as a fraction of its half span: a flat section's rounded rim.

capReach.description: How far a closed end, round or pointed, reaches along the run when nothing is drawn, a fraction of its length: a round end reaching the run's half width there is a semicircular tip. A few rings when left out.

drop.description: How far the run sits toward the underside when nothing is drawn, as a fraction of the axis length.

fills.description: A toe row whose end this run reaches when the row has no toes.

openV.description: Cut open at v = 0, so the run is a sheet: two faces meeting at an edge where v = 0 and v = 1 lie together.

shell.description: A thick section with a hollow in its front in place of the template's section, its cup and its rim.

TubeShell.description: A thick section with a hollow dished into its front: a full round back, a rim along each side and a hollow between the rims.

thickness.description: How deep the section is from front to back, a fraction of its half width.

hollow.description: How deep the hollow dishes into the front, a fraction of the thickness, up to 0.4.

rim.description: How wide the rim along each side is, a fraction of the half width.

u.description: The stretch of u the hollow runs over, deepening from its start and shallowing toward its end.
